status: preregistered synthetic software-integration fixture; validator tolerance review requested; implementation and comparison not run

sources.citation: Allen, R.G., Pereira, L.S., Raes, D. and Smith, M. (1998), Crop Evapotranspiration: Guidelines for Computing Crop Water Requirements, FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Chapter 8, Equations 80, 81 and 84.
sources.use: Equation 81 supports the single-crop-coefficient approximation ETc_adj = Ks × Kc × ETo when soil evaporation is not a large ET component. Equation 84 defines Ks from root-zone depletion, TAW and RAW.

sources.citation: Vanthoor, B.H.E., Stanghellini, C., van Henten, E.J. and de Visser, P.H.B. (2011), A methodology for model-based greenhouse design: Part 1, a greenhouse climate model for a broad range of designs and climates, Biosystems Engineering 110(4), 363–377.
sources.use: Primary reference for representing crop transpiration as an input to greenhouse air temperature and vapour-pressure dynamics. FarmFriend's existing environment solver remains a daily steady-state approximation and is not validated by this fixture.

fixtureClassification: synthetic software invariant only; not greenhouse calibration, measured comparison, reference-model agreement, or crop prediction

modelDispatch.historicalRule: crop-model-v4 with environment-v1 retains its committed lagged-potential climate behavior; environment-v2 is a separately versioned, frozen-input path
modelDispatch.newRunRule: ordinary new-run creation remains crop-model-v1/environment-v1 until the applicable acceptance gates pass

frozenSyntheticInputs.environmentLayout: open greenhouse layout with no placed equipment or crop-plane overlap
frozenSyntheticInputs.climateEquipment: all capacities zero; no equipment is installed
frozenSyntheticInputs.establishment: both cells already established before the tick; no germination, emergence or establishment flux is under test
frozenSyntheticInputs.humidityDomain: synthetic non-saturating greenhouse day; both expected RH outputs must remain below 100%

equations.dailyPotentialTranspirationPerCellMm: outdoor ETo (mm/day) × previous-day environment ET factor (dimensionless) × frozen Kc (dimensionless)
equations.dailyActualTranspirationPerCellMm: min(available root-zone water after declared boundary inputs, daily potential transpiration × current FAO-56 Ks)
equations.rootZoneStorageChangePerCellMm: inflows - runoff - deep drainage - actual transpiration; use unrounded internal values
equations.wholeEnvironmentTranspirationKgDay: sum over crop cells(actual transpiration mm/cell/day × cell area m² × 1 kg water/(mm·m²))
equations.singleUseConstraint: The same per-cell actual-transpiration value is debited once from root-zone storage and converted once into the whole-environment water-vapour source. Do not multiply by Ks or Kc again in either path.
equations.lagAndTemperatureOrdering: Use the previous day's frozen room ET factor for today's potential ET to avoid a same-day atmosphere-water algebraic loop. Use the previous day's room temperatures for today's dynamic root-development increment; when no prior room state exists, use the frozen outdoor temperatures. The resulting current room state affects tomorrow's potential ET and root-development temperature driver.
equations.environmentV1Preservation: This lagged, water-limited flux rule applies only to environment-v2. Existing environment-v1 replay equations are unchanged.

acceptanceChecks.fao56KsArithmetic: Wet Ks equals 1; dry Ks equals 0.5 for the frozen TAW, p and initial storage values.
acceptanceChecks.rootZoneToAirFlux: For each treatment, summed root-zone water loss in mm×m² equals environment transpiration input in kg/day within the preregistered 1e-12 numerical conversion tolerance.
acceptanceChecks.noDoubleStressOrCoefficient: Actual transpiration is ETo×previousEtFactor×Kc×Ks once; no second Ks/Kc multiplier is applied to its air input or root-zone debit.
acceptanceChecks.wetDryDirection: Wet treatment actual transpiration exceeds dry treatment actual transpiration, wet room RH exceeds dry room RH, and both room RH values remain below saturation.
acceptanceChecks.zeroLightAndCanopy: Known zero DLI yields exactly zero production; canopy and harvestable DM pools remain unchanged in both treatments.
acceptanceChecks.waterBalance: Each per-cell daily FAO-56 residual remains within the previously reviewed ≤1e-6 mm/cell-day closure tolerance; no storage reaches the 0 mm floor in this fixture.

toleranceReview.status: requested; no comparison authorized until independent review
toleranceReview.requestedScope: FAO-56 Ks arithmetic, one-use per-cell transpiration, mm×m² to kg/day conversion, fixed-point avoidance through explicit one-day lag, root-zone residual, and wet/dry directional climate response only

proposedTolerances.waterToAirFlux: ≤1e-12 kg/day absolute deviation after summing unrounded per-cell mm×m²
proposedTolerances.climateDirection: strict inequalities only; not an RH accuracy band

implementationStatus: not implemented; no reducer fixture comparison run
